name: Serve Robotics
sub: Sidewalk fleet on Uber Eats, targeting 2,000 robots by 2026
about: Sidewalk delivery robot company spun out of Postmates / Uber ecosystem. They operate through food delivery platforms and has a public-market profile.
deployment: LA, Miami, Chicago, Atlanta and other cities per public summaries.
metrics: Hit their 2,000-robot target by December 2025, a roughly twentyfold expansion in a year, making theirs the largest US sidewalk delivery fleet. Partnered with Uber Eats and DoorDash across LA, Miami, Dallas, Chicago and Atlanta.
signal: Reached 2,000 robots by December 2025, the largest US sidewalk fleet, reaching over 80% of the US food delivery market.

sources.title: Serve Robotics Builds 2,000 Autonomous Delivery Robots, Creating Largest Sidewalk Delivery Fleet in the U.S.
